context: Ravengard has fallen (or is presumed dead) and the party is confronted in the Upper City by Counsellor Florrick and a cadre of patriars and guards; Wyll is not present. Florrick arrives furious, spitting insults and accusing the party of conspiring with Ravengard’s “treacherous spawn,” repeating Lady Mizora’s claim that Wyll murdered his father and craves power. She explains that before Ravengard was taken he asked her to seek out Wyll with a message: Wyll — as a true champion — must rouse a bronze wyrm called Ansur to save Baldur’s Gate, and there is an ancient epic, The Legend of Ansur, that was stolen and must be found. Florrick and her allies are primed for battle but will stand down if the player will carry the message to Wyll and help recover the tome.
